A '''vibropick''' was a common tool with vibration capabilities, and was a powered version of the standard [[Pick (tool)|Pick]]. They usually retailed for around fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and were readily available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWS" />
